description: This file declares the WiFiManager class, which implements a plugin for managing WiFi via JSONRPC in the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for WiFi operations, event handlers, and interface setup.

classes.name: WiFiManager
classes.description: A plugin class for WiFi management, providing JSONRPC methods, event handling, and interface registration within WPEFramework.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID for future connection.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Gets information about the paired SSID.
